summary: A checkpoint's known writers are found with one seek per writer instead of reading every replica envelope's index entry, which on a large node was hundreds of megabytes on each fault snapshot

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change; the same writers are found.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change; the seek uses the existing primary keys.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules, participants and digests unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Nothing outside the node sees the change.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an older build restores the full read.
